title: AI voice calling agent in Telugu
seoTitle: Telugu Voice Agents: AI Calling in Telugu for Business
metaDescription: What Telugu voice agents can handle, how they deal with Tenglish, Telangana and Andhra speech and local units, and how to set one up for real callers.
shortAnswer: Telugu voice agents answer and make business calls in Telugu: enquiries, bookings, reminders and lead follow-ups. A good one greets in Telugu, uses garu after a name, follows the English words callers mix in, and understands callers from Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. It hands complex calls to your team and saves a transcript of every call.
excerpt: Telugu callers from Hyderabad, Vijayawada and Vizag speak differently, mix in English and Hindi, and expect respect on the phone. Here is what a Telugu AI voice calling agent should do, and how to set one up.

sections.heading: What can Telugu voice agents do for a business?
paragraphs: Telugu is one of India's largest languages. The 2011 Census counted about 8.11 crore Telugu speakers, 6.7% of the population, most of them in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. For a business in either state, a large share of callers would rather speak Telugu than English or Hindi.

A Telugu AI voice calling agent answers your phone line and website in Telugu, makes follow-up and reminder calls, and saves a transcript and summary of each call. Our [Telugu AI voice calling agent page](/languages/telugu) has sample lines and a written clinic booking, and the [AI receptionist overview](/ai-receptionist) shows how front-desk calls are answered, booked and handed over.
points: Inbound: enquiries, timings, directions and bookings.
Outbound: confirmations, reminders and new-lead callbacks.
Website: a voice button that answers visitors in Telugu.

sections.heading: How do Telugu voice agents handle Tenglish?
paragraphs: Hyderabad callers often switch to English for words like appointment, slot, EMI, booking or a flat size. A good agent understands those words without asking the caller to repeat them in Telugu, keeps replying in Telugu, and moves to English if the caller does.

Vistrow Voice can speak more than 130 languages, including Hindi, English and nine other Indian languages (Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Bengali, Punjabi, Odia). Some Hyderabad callers move to Hindi altogether, and the same agent can follow them there. Our guide on [choosing a multilingual voice agent](/resources/blog/how-to-choose-a-multilingual-voice-agent) explains how to test language switching, and the [Hindi AI voice agent guide](/resources/blog/hindi-ai-voice-agent) covers how Hinglish callers behave.

sections.heading: Does it understand both Telangana and Andhra speech?
paragraphs: Hyderabad Telugu borrows Hindi and Urdu words, while coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema callers sound different again. An agent that only hears one variety in testing can mishear the others. If you serve both states, recruit test callers from each region before launch.

Include older callers and callers on noisy lines in the test group, since they are often the ones who most want Telugu. Check that the agent waits for slow speakers to finish, and that it asks once, politely, when it did not catch something rather than guessing.

The [Kannada voice agent test plan](/resources/blog/ai-voice-calling-agent-in-kannada) works just as well for Telugu: test the greeting, the language mix, regional speech, local names, numbers and handoffs, on quiet and noisy lines. The [Testing Lab guide](/help/testing-lab/run-a-test) explains how to save those cases and run them again after each change.

sections.heading: How should a Telugu agent greet and address callers?
paragraphs: Write the welcome message in Telugu script, opening with నమస్కారం, rather than in romanised Telugu, so the voice pronounces it properly. Callers expect garu after their name; say so in the agent prompt and the agent will keep doing it.

Keep sentences short and polite, and use English product words where callers already use them. Preview a few voices in your browser first; the [voice selection guide](/help/voices/choose-voices) shows how. If calls are recorded, the opening line can also say that the call is recorded and that the caller is speaking with an AI assistant.

sections.heading: Which Telugu calls are best to automate first?
paragraphs: Start with calls that repeat and follow a clear script. Clinic and diagnostic appointment lines in Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Guntur, Warangal or Tirupati are a common first step, since many patients would rather not navigate an English menu. Property enquiries in Hyderabad are another; the [Telugu real estate calling page for Hyderabad](/solutions/real-estate/telugu-ai-calling-agent-hyderabad-real-estate) shows how buyers are qualified.

Coaching and admission enquiries from Telugu-speaking families, and new-lead callbacks across both states, round out the list. For lead calls, the [AI telecaller for lead follow-ups](/ai-telecaller) explains how new enquiries are called back and qualified.
points: Callbacks to new leads from ads and forms.

sections.heading: How does it capture square yards, lakhs and names correctly?
paragraphs: Amounts are usually said in lakhs and crores, often in English, and Hyderabad plots are commonly quoted in square yards. Put the units you actually use into the [knowledge base for approved answers](/product/knowledge-base), and switch on strict mode so prices and availability come only from what you approved.

Then define post-call fields for the details your team needs, such as budget, plot size, preferred area or appointment date. Each value is pulled from the transcript, so your team reads sizes and budgets the way they are used to. Test with a caller who corrects a figure mid-call to make sure the later value wins.

Names matter as much as numbers. Telugu names can be long and are often shortened on the phone, so ask the agent to confirm the name once and save it the way the caller said it. Your team can then greet the caller by the same name when they call back.

sections.heading: How should you pilot Telugu voice agents?
paragraphs: Start with one line or one website page and one job, such as clinic bookings or property enquiries. Load your timings, services, localities and units, test with callers from each region you serve, and then go live for a week.

Read every transcript daily in that first week. Note each misheard word, awkward phrase or wrong handover, fix the cause in the prompt, knowledge base or post-call fields, and test the same case again. The guide to [AI call recordings and transcripts](/resources/blog/ai-call-recordings-and-transcripts) shows what to look for. Once results are steady, add outbound reminders or follow-up calls.

sections.heading: What happens when a Telugu caller needs a person?
paragraphs: On phone calls, set a transfer number. The agent dials your colleague into the call and stays on until they answer; if nobody picks up, it takes a callback request with a preferred time. The [functions and transfer guide](/help/agents/agent-functions-and-transfer) covers the settings.

A call started from the [website voice widget](/product/widget) cannot be transferred to a phone, so there the agent takes a callback number instead. Whoever takes the transfer or callback should speak Telugu, so the caller does not have to start again in another language. Agree who covers Telugu callbacks on each shift before you go live.

faqs.q: Can an AI voice agent speak Telugu on phone calls?
faqs.a: Yes. It answers and makes phone calls in Telugu and answers website widget calls, saving a transcript of each. Phone numbers connect through your own telephony provider.

faqs.q: Does it understand Hyderabad Telugu mixed with Hindi and English?
faqs.a: It follows everyday Telugu with English words inside a sentence and can switch to Hindi or English when the caller does. Test with callers from each region you serve.

faqs.q: Can it address callers with garu?
faqs.a: Yes. Ask for it in the agent prompt, for example using garu after the caller's name, and check it on test calls before launch.

faqs.q: Can it book appointments in Telugu?
faqs.a: Yes. It offers free slots inside the business hours you set in the built-in Appointments calendar and confirms once the booking is saved.

faqs.q: Which other languages can the same agent speak?
faqs.a: More than 130, including Hindi, English, Kannada, Tamil and the other supported Indian languages, so callers can switch mid-call.
